lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Stay close. These ruins shift when you're not looking.
lines.monologue: Two days since I found him. He still flinches at loud sounds.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: The walls here... they feel thin. Like something is pressing through from the other side.
lines.lens: His hand hovers near the stone but doesn't touch it. Instinct, not thought.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: There. That archway. The light bends wrong around it.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: But I believe him. He sees edges I can't.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: It's not visual. It's more like... the space there is tired. Worn thin from too much passing through.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: You talk about space like it has feelings.
lines.lens: File that. His perception works differently than mine — not worse, just sideways.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: Maybe it does. I wouldn't know. I barely know what I have feelings about.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Then we figure that out too. One thing at a time.
lines.monologue: He's not fragile. He's just... unfinished. Like a sentence someone stopped writing.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: One thing at a time. I can do that.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Movement ahead. Something low to the ground.
lines.lens: Three contact points visible. Slime variant. Non-aggressive unless cornered, but we're in its corridor.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Stay behind me until you remember how to fight. Or if you remember.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.text: What if I remember something worse than fighting?

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Then we deal with that too.
lines.monologue: Not a lie. Not entirely the truth either.
